demo.rain_speed_mps.source_note: Severe waterlogging speed-restriction surrogate for a staged demo. TODO: observe wet-weather speeds at LIG. Not a measured monsoon effect.

demo.rain_end_s.source_note: Short repeatable restriction duration. TODO: collect incident durations; this timing is not an ML feature.

demo.horizon_s.source_note: Bounded demo drain. Unfinished journeys remain invalid for comparison.

demo.step_s.source_note: Engineering timestep inherited from the harness; not field data.

demo.decision_margin_m.source_note: Conservative demo turn rejection margin, not a road-safety standard. TODO: validate maneuver constraints.

demo.guidance_lifetime_s.source_note: Prototype advisory expiry; late turns are rejected separately.

demo.cohort.source_note: 12 vehicles placed on two lanes at time zero to support a short demonstration. NOT an observed Indian fleet mix. TODO: replace with a declared field-informed cohort after stability testing.

fleet_mix_reference.source_note: Original exploratory harness weights; not used as measured proportions or as probabilities in the staged demo. TODO: count vehicles at LIG.

speed_limits.source_note: Imported/converter lane limits; per-road field provenance is not established. TODO: record signage and verify OSM/default assignments.

demo.reference_speed_mps.source_note: Reference is min(imported lane limit, this cap). Not a measured normal-traffic speed. TODO: measure quiet conditions.

signal_timing.source_note: Existing imported demonstration signal plan, unchanged by guidance. TODO: stopwatch actual LIG phases; not a safety-standard claim.

evening_peak_shape.value: 12 staged departures at time zero; no measured peak curve
evening_peak_shape.source_note: Evening is a narrative setting, not demand calibration. TODO: collect quiet and rush 10-minute counts.

left_hand_traffic.source_note: Left-hand network setting chosen for the Indian demonstration; geometry is already built this way. TODO: verify turns in field footage. Changing this requires a new network.

sublane.source_note: Disabled in the small lane-based demo for reproducible stability. Not calibrated lane-independent Indian driving.

driving_profile.source_note: Conservative deterministic demonstration parameters. TODO: field validation; defaults are not behavioral evidence.

demo.rule_slowdown.source_note: Rule prototype threshold, not a trained or validated Indian congestion classifier.

demo.rule_duration_s.source_note: Continuous fresh evidence requirement. TODO: validate detection precision against independent labels.

installed_bypass_sensor.value: SUMO lane-area detectors on every lane of route_b[1]
installed_bypass_sensor.source_note: Declared capacity guard input, not hidden whole-network truth and not a real sensor installed at LIG. Slowdown triggering uses validated phone samples only. TODO: establish real bypass coverage before deployment.

vehicle_specs.source_note: Unvalidated vehicle dimensions, acceleration, gaps, speeds and emission proxies. TODO: validate heterogeneous fleet settings; e-rickshaw default emissions are not realistic.
